name: Evie & Ivy's Room
body:
The back-facing room opens through glass doors directly into the 88-acre garden, and the line between bedroom and greenhouse barely exists. Pots, herbs and a potting bench spill into the living space, vines edging the bookshelves and reaching for the bed. Ivy insists on mint and lavender at the windows.

EVIE TUCKS HER HIDDEN STASH OF JOURNALS under the soil trays where she thinks Ivy will not find them. Ivy always finds them.

Nights end curled in the garden nook, Evie reading aloud while Ivy hums along to the rustle of leaves and the whole room breathes green. Oak four-poster with hanging planters woven into the canopy. Ivy is the only Heart PAWG in Ghost Haven, and she is thirty feet from her own tomatoes.
